_description: 技能注册中心 -- 记录所有自动结晶的技能，支持版本控制和回滚

skills.name: PDF text extraction fallback
skills.trigger: Node.js pdfjs-dist fails or PDF text extraction needed
pipeline: Try PyMuPDF (fitz): pip install pymupdf
fitz.open(path) -> page.get_text() per page
Fallback to pdfminer.six if fails

skills.name: SPA/Vue.js page content extraction
skills.trigger: curl only returns SPA empty shell HTML (Vue.js etc)
pipeline: Bypass DNS via IP + --resolve to get JS bundle
Search JS for service-api/ to find backend API routes
Request JSON data directly via API route
Fallback to xbrowser (Edge headed mode) if API restricted

skills.name: DNS block bypass
skills.trigger: Domain DNS hijacked or unresolvable
pipeline: nslookup domain 8.8.8.8 to get real IP
curl.exe -s --resolve domain:443:IP https://domain/
Python: ProxyHandler({}) to bypass system proxy
Last resort: modify hosts file temporarily

skills.name: Windows encoding handling
skills.trigger: Unicode characters cause UnicodeEncodeError under PowerShell GBK
pipeline: Avoid printing Chinese/special chars directly to terminal
Write to file (encoding='utf-8') instead
Python: sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
Use write_file.py (qclaw-text-file) for final output

skills.name: Cross-session continuity
skills.trigger: Need to continue work from previous session
pipeline: Read LCM summary for previous session context
Find artifact files written by previous session
Skip previously verified failed paths
Use already confirmed working solutions directly

skills.name: User preference triple sync
skills.trigger: User specified a tool preference or workflow
pipeline: Write to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md (today's memory)
Write to TOOLS.md (tool preferences)
Write to MEMORY.md (long-term memory - user preferences)

skills.name: Command-line compatibility
skills.trigger: Running shell commands under PowerShell
pipeline: Use curl.exe not curl (PowerShell alias Invoke-WebRequest)
Use cmd /c for commands containing &&
pip [notice] is just upgrade reminder, not an error
Judge success by actual functionality not exit code

skills.name: GenericAgent_Architecture_Migration
skills.trigger: Need to upgrade skill system with self-evolving architecture
pipeline: Study GenericAgent README for architecture design patterns
Create skill-registry.json as versioned skill catalog
Build crystallize.py pipeline for auto skill extraction
Add validate.py for integrity checking
Add rollback.py for version rollback support
Upgrade SKILL.md with layered memory (L0-L4) and 9 atomic tool mapping
Set up weekly cron for automated evolution maintenance

skills.name: SAGENT_4.0_GNN_Router
skills.trigger: Need to route a task to the best matching skill using graph-based reasoning
pipeline: Parse task into keyword features
Query SkillGraph for top-k candidates
Apply GNN propagation for confidence refinement
Run dual verification: GNN propose + LLM review
If strong match, suggest skill; if not, trigger crystallization

Extract target objects

skills.name: Dynamic_Verification_Loop
skills.trigger: Need to verify execution plan quality and auto-retry with degraded fallback
pipeline: Generate execution plan from chain.py
Verify: confidence check, tool availability, dependency completeness
If issues found: auto-adjust and regenerate (max 2 retries)
If all retries fail: use simplified degraded plan
Record retry count and final result to routing log

skills.name: Skill Co-occurrence Edge Tracker
skills.trigger: Multiple skills used together OR need skill complement recommendation
pipeline: Record skills used together per task
Track co-occurrence frequency + success rate
Compute synergy_gain = co_rate - avg(solo_rates)
Recommend complementary skills for current task
Output: co_occurrence.json edges + node_stats

skills.name: Skill Causal Edge Tracker

pipeline: Record skill execution sequences + results
Analyze A_success -> B_success conditional probability
Classify edge type: enhancer / prerequisite / blocker
Suggest optimal execution order via topological sort
Output: causal_edges.json + sequence optimizer

skills.name: Four-Layer Memory Hierarchy
skills.trigger: Session end OR daily cleanup OR need cross-turn memory recall
pipeline: L1 Register: per-turn ephemeral -> memory/register/{turn}.json
L1->L2: auto-promote (importance>=0.6) -> memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md
L2->L3: key findings -> MEMORY.md long-term
L3->L4: auto-index to VectorStore LanceDB
Recall: query across short/long/persistent layers
skills.source_pattern: KernelGOD v8 — 九大闭环#6 记忆闭环 (P1)

skills.name: SQLite Relational Database Adapter
skills.trigger: JSON query slow OR need structured analytics OR task/skill/evaluation logging
pipeline: Initialize SQLite DB: tasks / skill_usage / evaluations tables
Insert task records with hash tracking
Log skill usage per execution
Record 4-dim evaluation results
Query: top_failing / success_trend / skill_stats

skills.name: Real Vector Embedding (ST/TF-IDF fallback)
skills.trigger: Semantic search OR vector-based skill matching OR sentence similarity
pipeline: Try: from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
If ST available: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim, 80MB model)
Fallback: TF-IDF with bigram features (384-dim, zero deps)
Normalize vectors to unit length for cosine similarity
Auto-detect at import time, expose via VectorStore.vectorizer

skills.name: Tool Executable Validator

pipeline: Scan tools list
Check path existence
Run --version
Check pip/npm packages
Auto-detect degradation

skills.name: Task Quality Evaluator

pipeline: 5-dim scoring: completeness/accuracy/efficiency/tool_health/degradation
Auto suggestions for retry

skills.name: Evolution Pipeline

pipeline: Detect from co-occurrence/causal/quality
Generate candidates
Quality gate: confidence>=0.6 + dedup
Auto-crystallize

skills.name: Adaptive Auto Tuner

pipeline: Load 7-day quality log
Compute metrics: retry_rate/degradation/acceptance
Generate adjustments for 5 params
Apply + save

skills.name: Skill Health Monitor
skills.trigger: Periodic check OR skill degradation suspected
pipeline: HealthCard per skill: success_rate/confidence_trend/response_trend
State: healthy->degraded->critical->needs_intervention
Alert on 3+ consecutive failures

skills.name: Cross-Task Knowledge Transfer

Compute similarity to high-quality tasks
Detect domain analogy (pdf<->docx)
Suggest improvement transfer

skills.name: System Controller — neural symbiosis

pipeline: TaskPlanner: LLM understand task -> system verify plan
DecisionCoordinator: system select skills -> route

ControlMode: system_driven/hybrid/llm_driven

skills.name: Sync-Obsidian (PARA Methodology)
skills.trigger: 同步Obsidian OR 备份记忆 OR update obsidian OR memory sync
pipeline: Step 1: Read memory/*.md + MEMORY.md
Step 2: Convert to Obsidian format (Wiki links, tags, frontmatter)
Step 3: Write to D:/Obsidian/Inbox/
Step 4: Update mission-control/memory-index/

skills.name: Windows-Cron-Adapter
skills.trigger: 定时任务 OR cron OR 计划任务 OR schtasks
pipeline: Step 1: schtasks /Query /FO CSV /NH to list all tasks
Step 2: schtasks /Create /SC DAILY /ST HH:MM /TN TaskName /TR cmd.exe /c ...
Step 3: schtasks /Query /TN TaskName to verify
Step 4: Write to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md

skills.name: Gateway-Restart-Diagnostics
skills.trigger: 网关重启 OR gateway restart OR node.exe 崩溃 OR QClaw 连不上
pipeline: Step 1: Check node.exe process (Get-Process node)
Step 2: Read gateway log (openclaw.log)
Step 3: Attempt graceful restart (gateway restart)
Step 4: Verify port 18789 is listening
Step 5: Log result to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md

skills.name: WB-Bridge-Protocol
skills.trigger: WorkBuddy OR WB桥接 OR mcp_chat OR 跨AI通信
pipeline: Step 1: Write message to mcp_chat/{task_id}.in.json
Step 2: Wait for {task_id}.out.json (poll every 10s, max 120s)
Step 3: ACK the response (write status/{task_id}.json)
Step 4: Handle timeout (retry OR fallback to oc_daemon)
skills.evolution_notes: 从 WorkBuddy 桥接经验萃取

skills.name: Log-Aggregation-Analyzer
skills.trigger: 分析日志 OR log analysis OR 聚合日志 OR 错误趋势
pipeline: Step 1: Scan D:\openclaw\logs\*.log
Step 2: Extract errors/warnings with timestamps
Step 3: Aggregate by error type and frequency
Step 4: Generate report (markdown table)
Step 5: Save to workspace/log-report-YYYYMMDD.md

skills.name: Optimization-Loop
skills.trigger: optimization OR retry OR self-healing OR LLM fix OR task failure
pipeline: Step 1: Execute task_fn with args/kwargs
Step 2: On failure, call LLM generator to produce fix plan
Step 3: Apply retry delay (configurable)
Step 4: Re-execute with same args (max 2 retries)
Step 5: Return OptimizationResult with all attempt records

skills.name: Reality Perception Loop (S3 ActivePerception)
skills.trigger: 系统资源监控 OR CPU/MEM/DISK OR 进程状态 OR 网络连通 OR 现实感知
pipeline: cpu_usage() -> percent/per_cpu/count/freq
memory_usage() -> total/available/used/free/percent
disk_usage(paths) -> total/used/free/percent per path
process_list(filter) -> pid/name/memory_mb/cmdline
network_status() -> interfaces/io_stats/connectivity
snapshot() -> full system state dict
to_s3_format() -> KernelGOD S3 perception packet
skills.evolution_notes: KernelGOD v8 第②环 — 现实感知闭环

skills.name: Obsidian Vault Sync

pipeline: Identify changed memory files in memory/*.md
Map content to Obsidian vault (D:\Obsidian) PARA structure
Convert markdown headers to Obsidian-compatible format
Write synced files with frontmatter metadata
Log sync status to memory/obsidian-sync.log

skills.name: Gateway Health Diagnostics & Recovery
skills.trigger: Gateway service (node.exe) unresponsive, missing, or port check fails
pipeline: Check process: tasklist | findstr node.exe to find PID
Check port: netstat -ano | findstr :18789 for gateway
Read recent logs: D:\openclaw\logs\*.log for error patterns
Safe restart: openclaw gateway restart with 5s delay
Verify: curl http://127.0.0.1:18789/status within 10s timeout
Fallback: if restart fails, check config conflicts

skills.name: CSV/Excel Quick Analysis
skills.trigger: User provides tabular data (CSV, XLSX, TSV) and asks for analysis or insights
pipeline: Detect encoding: chardet or BOM check for CSV
Load with pandas (fallback to csv module if pandas unavailable)
Generate statistical summary: describe(), null counts, dtypes
Identify top-N patterns: top values, correlations, outliers
Output structured insight report in markdown

skills.name: Data Chart Generator
skills.trigger: User requests visualization, chart, or graph from data
pipeline: Analyze data shape: pick chart type (bar/line/pie/scatter/histogram)
Generate with matplotlib: set Chinese font (SimHei), labels, legend
Save as PNG to workspace/charts/ with timestamp
Optionally generate HTML interactive version with plotly
Return chart path and key insights

skills.name: Git Smart Commit
skills.trigger: Code changes detected in workspace git repo that need committing
pipeline: git status --porcelain to list changes
Categorize: new files, modified, deleted, renamed
Generate commit message: type(scope): description format
Stage: git add with selective staging (avoid mass add)
Commit: git commit -m with generated message
Optionally: git push to remote

skills.name: Code Diff Reviewer
skills.trigger: User asks for code review, quality check, or pull request review
pipeline: git diff HEAD~1 or between specified refs to get changes
Classify changes: logic, config, docs, tests, refactor
Check: style violations, potential bugs, security issues, missing tests
Generate review: summary + file-level comments + overall risk score
Output as markdown with severity markers (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)

skills.name: Retry Strategy Selector
skills.trigger: Operation fails and needs intelligent retry with backoff
pipeline: Parse error type: network timeout, rate-limit (429), server error (5xx), auth (401/403)
Select strategy: linear backoff (timeout), exponential (rate-limit), circuit-breaker (5xx burst), abort (auth)
Set max_retries: 3 for timeout, 5 for 429 with Retry-After header, 2 for 5xx
Execute retry loop with jitter (random 0-500ms)
Log all attempts and final result to structured output

skills.name: Batch File Processor
skills.trigger: Multiple files need the same operation (rename, convert, compress, search)
pipeline: Scan directory: glob/recursive with file type filter
Build operation plan: file count, total size, estimated time
Execute in parallel: ThreadPoolExecutor for I/O, asyncio for network
Track progress: completed/total, speed, ETA
Error handling: skip failed files, collect errors, retry on transient
Generate summary report: success count, failures, skipped, total size processed

skills.name: Structured Report Generator
skills.trigger: User needs a formal report, document, or summary from structured data or analysis
pipeline: Select template: analysis-report, meeting-notes, project-status, incident-report
Populate sections: title, summary, details, findings, recommendations
Format: markdown with TOC, tables, code blocks, charts (if applicable)
Export options: .md (default), .docx (via python-docx), .pdf (via weasyprint)
Validate: check all sections filled, no placeholder text remaining

skills.name: Network Diagnostics
skills.trigger: Network issues detected: connection failures, DNS problems, proxy errors, or SSL errors
pipeline: DNS check: nslookup + resolve test for critical domains
Port check: Test-NetConnection / nc for gateway (18789, 18998)
Proxy check: check system proxy settings, test bypass
SSL check: openssl s_client for certificate chain and expiry
Bandwidth: measure latency and throughput to key endpoints
Output diagnostic matrix: component, status, detail, recommendation

skills.name: Windows Service Manager
skills.trigger: Windows service needs start/stop/query/configure
pipeline: Get-Service | Where-Object Status/Name matches pattern
Start/Stop-Service with -Force and timeout handling
Set-Service: set startup type (automatic/manual/disabled)
Read service logs: Get-EventLog -LogName System -Source Service*
Recovery: sc.exe failure flags to auto-restart on crash

skills.name: Registry Safe Editor
skills.trigger: Windows registry read/modify/backup needed
pipeline: Backup: reg export HKLM\Path\Key backup.reg /y
Read: Get-ItemProperty -Path Registry::HKEY... -Name ValueName
Write: Set-ItemProperty with validation (read-back check)
Delete: Remove-ItemProperty with confirmation
Rollback plan: if write fails, restore from backup.reg

skills.name: SSL Certificate Checker
skills.trigger: HTTPS endpoint certificate needs validation or expiry check
pipeline: Connect: openssl s_client -connect host:port -servername host
Extract: x509 certificate details (subject, issuer, dates, SAN)
Check expiry: days_remaining = not_after - today
Verify chain: openssl verify -CAfile ca-bundle.crt cert.pem
Output: JSON with expiry_status, chain_valid, grade (A-F)

skills.name: File Permission Auditor
skills.trigger: Directory or file permission audit needed (Windows/Linux)
pipeline: Scan: Get-Acl -Path directory -Recurse | Where-Object {...}
Extract: identity, filesystem rights, is_inherited, is_inherited
Anomaly detect: Everyone/FULLCONTROL, Anonymous, No owner
Compare: expected vs actual ACLs from policy definition
Report: CSV (path, identity, permission, risk_level)

skills.name: Configuration Migration Helper
skills.trigger: Old system config needs migration to new format or new machine
pipeline: Read old config: parse JSON/YAML/TOML/INI with schema detection
Map fields: old_key → new_key with transformation rules
Handle missing: default values, prompt user, or skip with warning
Validate new: schema check, type check, required field check
Write new: atomic write with .bak backup of existing new config

skills.name: Quick Test Scaffold
skills.trigger: New module or function needs test coverage
pipeline: Analyze module: functions, classes, public API, dependencies
Generate pytest scaffold: test_file.py with fixtures and parametrize
Mock external: unittest.mock or pytest-mock for I/O, network, time
Run: pytest test_file.py --tb=short -v
Coverage: pytest --cov=module --cov-report=term-missing

skills.name: Regression Detector
skills.trigger: Suspected regression: something worked before, broken now
pipeline: git bisect start HEAD good_commit (identify range)
git bisect run pytest tests/ (automated bisection)
Parse result: first bad commit hash, author, date, message
Analyze: diff of bad commit, identify root cause
Report: markdown with commit info, root cause, fix suggestion

skills.name: Environment Validator
skills.trigger: Before deployment: validate all required tools/versions/paths exist
pipeline: Read requirements: .env.example, requirements.txt, package.json, etc.
Check tools: command -v tool or Get-Command tool (cross-platform)
Check versions: tool --version, compare with semver constraints
Check paths: Test-Path or os.path.exists for required directories
Output matrix: component, required, found, status (pass/warn/fail)
